seo.title: Our Event Planning Process — From Idea to Unforgettable
seo.description: How S59 Events works: consultation, bespoke concept, budget, venues and suppliers, design and production, guest experience, flawless event-day management and aftercare.

hero.title: You enjoy the experience. *We manage the process.*
hero.subtitle: A clear, carefully structured process — so that every detail is under control and you can enjoy the journey as much as the event itself.

steps.title: Consultation & brief
steps.text: We begin with a personal meeting to understand your goals, your wishes and the atmosphere you want to create. We discuss the format, date, number of guests, budget and level of service. Our aim is not just to receive a brief, but to understand the emotions you want to give your guests.

steps.title: Concept & proposal
steps.text: We develop the idea, theme and atmosphere of your event, with moodboards, visual references and the structure of the programme. You receive a tailored proposal with the concept, recommendations for venues and design, a preliminary budget and the proposed package. We don't hand you a list of options to figure out — we bring considered recommendations.

steps.title: Confirmation & planning
steps.text: Once the proposal is approved, we sign the agreement, confirm the budget and scope, and assign your personal Event Manager. Together, we agree on a communication schedule and the key milestones of the project.

steps.title: Venue, partners & design
steps.text: We select and secure the venue, curate and coordinate every supplier — décor, florals, catering, photography, technical teams, artists — and oversee the production of every bespoke element. The budget is monitored at every stage, and any change is agreed with you before it happens.

steps.title: Guests & programme
steps.text: We manage invitations, RSVPs and seating, prepare the welcome experience, gifts and personal touches, and arrange transfers or accommodation when needed. In parallel, we build the programme: hosts, music, performances and interactive moments, all aligned to a precise timeline.

steps.title: Final preparations
steps.text: Before the event, we confirm every supplier, check the venue and technical setup, finalise the timeline and guest numbers, brief the team and prepare alternative solutions for any unforeseen situation.

steps.title: The event day
steps.text: Our team oversees set-up, checks every element, coordinates suppliers, welcomes your guests and keeps the timeline flowing. Any question is resolved quietly, without involving you — so you can be fully present.

steps.title: Aftercare
steps.text: We supervise breakdown, close all organisational and financial matters, deliver photos and videos once prepared by our partners, and ask for your feedback. For us, the relationship doesn't end when the event does.

privacy.title: Privacy *Policy*
privacy.body:
This Privacy Policy explains how S59 Events processes personal data submitted through this website.

**Data controller**
The controller of your personal data is S59 Events, Warsaw, Poland. Company details are listed in the footer of this website. You can contact us using the details on the Enquire page.

**What data we collect**
When you submit an enquiry, we collect the information you provide: your name, email address, phone number, company (if given) and details about your planned event. We also store technical information required for the security of the website.

**Why we process your data**
We process your data to respond to your enquiry, prepare a proposal and, if you decide to work with us, to plan and deliver your event (Art. 6(1)(b) GDPR), and on the basis of your consent given in the form (Art. 6(1)(a) GDPR).

**How long we keep your data**
Enquiries that do not lead to cooperation are deleted no later than 24 months after the last contact. Data of clients is kept for as long as required by accounting and tax law.

**Who receives your data**
Your data may be processed by our hosting and email providers and by trusted partners involved in your event, only to the extent necessary. We never sell your data.

**Your rights**
You have the right to access, rectify and delete your data, to restrict processing, to data portability, to withdraw consent at any time and to lodge a complaint with the President of the Personal Data Protection Office (UODO).

**Contact**
For any questions about your data, please contact us using the details on the Enquire page.

If we add analytics or marketing tools in the future, we will ask for your consent first and update this policy.

You can delete or block cookies at any time in your browser settings.
